def: The serum, or watery part, of milk, separated from the morethick or coagulable part, esp. in the process of making cheese. Inthis process, the thick part is called curd, and the thin part whey.
Of or pertaining to the tribe of ruminants of which the goat,or genus Capra, is the type.
A double thiophene nucleus, C6H4S2, analogous to thionaphthene,and the base of a large series of compounds. [Written alsothiophtene.]
To reverse or recant, as a previous decision.
A liquid ketone obtained by heating calcium butyrate.
To dose to excess; to give an overdose, or too many doses, to.
Anything producing torment, annoyance, or pain. [Obs.] Chaucer.
